C dep001.need-confirm OL DEP-001 MUST ;; A dependency must solve a concrete current requirement. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep002.approved-first OL DEP-002 MUST ;; Use/prefer the approved technology or package for the capability when one exists. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep017.asp-versioning OL DEP-017 DEFAULT ;; Add a versioning package only after Controller API versioning is explicitly adopted; then use Asp.Versioning.Mvc (+ ApiExplorer for documentation grouping). ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep020.resilience-default OL DEP-020 DEFAULT ;; When resilience is required prefer Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience (HttpClient) and Microsoft.Extensions.Resilience (general); direct Polly only when a concrete requirement cannot be expressed through them. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.no-polly-integration EX DEP-020,DEP-004 MUST_NOT ;; Never add the deprecated Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Polly or Polly.Extensions.Http integrations. ;; = ;; none ;; Package-specific prohibition beyond DEP-020.
C x.polly-document EX DEP-020 MUST ;; Document why direct Polly is used. ;; = ;; none ;; Documentation obligation not in DEP-020.
C x.no-legacy-autovalidation EX DEP-010 MUST_NOT ;; Do not add deprecated or legacy ASP.NET automatic-validation integration packages merely to connect FluentValidation to the pipeline. ;; = ;; none ;; Not stated in DEP-010.
C dep003.version-selection OL DEP-003 MUST ;; Determine the latest stable version compatible with framework/runtime and peers, verified from the registry; no prerelease unless explicitly requested; 'latest' means latest stable compatible. ;; = ;; Prerelease on explicit request. ;;
C dep004.due-diligence OL DEP-004 MUST ;; Before installing check deprecation, known vulnerabilities and the exact version's license (registry, upstream when needed); free download does not imply acceptability. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep005.permissive-ok OL DEP-005 ALLOWED ;; Permissive licenses commonly suitable for commercial use (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD) may be accepted. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep005.license-gate OL DEP-005 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Do not install automatically paid/commercial or materially restrictive/unclassifiable-licence dependencies; explain, present alternatives, never silently substitute, say when no free alternative exists. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.no-legal-conclusions EX DEP-005 MUST_NOT ;; Do not make legal conclusions beyond what published license information supports. ;; = ;; none ;; Restraint not stated in DEP-005.
C dep006.install-nuget OL DEP-006 MUST ;; NuGet: add/update PackageVersion in Directory.Packages.props and a versionless PackageReference in the narrowest project. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep007.install-npm OL DEP-007 MUST ;; npm: install into the correct dependency category and keep package-lock.json consistent. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep025.no-force OL DEP-025 MUST_NOT ;; Do not use --force or --legacy-peer-deps merely to bypass incompatible peers; resolve the actual problem. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.check-manifests-run OL WF-007,DEP-004 MUST ;; Run check-manifests.js, then ecosystem vulnerability information when security-relevant or verifying the dependency. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.scanner-context OL WF-020,GOV-014 MUST_NOT ;; Scanner output requires context; do not automatically replace/upgrade unrelated packages because of a scanner finding. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.remove-dead-refs EX DEP-001 MUST ;; Remove no-longer-used dependencies when part of the current change and safe to verify; leave no dead package references. ;; = ;; Within the current change. ;; Dead-reference removal obligation not in the oracle.
C gov014.no-unrelated-cleanup OL GOV-014 MUST_NOT ;; No unrelated dependency cleanup during a narrowly scoped task. ;; = ;; none ;;

75 NN ;; Heading.
77-84 OL [api022.deprecation]

C gov017.classify-step OL GOV-017 MUST ;; Classify with Decision Control (classes, Reserved list, five-question test); Decided and Delegated need no request. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.wait-interactive OL GOV-017 MUST ;; In an interactive session wait for an explicit answer before implementing the Reserved part. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.record-same-change EX GOV-007 MUST ;; Record an accepted decision in the same change that implements it. ;; = ;; none ;; Sequencing obligation not in the oracle.
C x.adr-record EX GOV-017,GOV-007 MUST ;; Architecture, stack, convention or public-contract decisions are recorded as docs/decisions/NNNN-short-title.md (Status, Context, Decision, Consequences) and the affected decision record is updated. ;; = ;; none ;; ADR convention not in the oracle.
C gov007.sync-behaviour OL GOV-007 MUST ;; When a new behavioural rule is approved update the durable source of truth, including SPECIFICATION.md when appropriate. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.rejected-record EX GOV-017 ALLOWED ;; Record a rejected request only when the rejection is itself a durable decision (e.g. a pattern ruled out). ;; = ;; none ;; Recording practice beyond the oracle.
C gov006.declared-property OL GOV-006,GOV-004 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; An observable declared-property change (e.g. effective string comparison) must not happen silently; treat it as a product decision. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api022.deprecation OL API-022 MUST ;; Deprecating an external version: mark in versioning metadata, document the replacement, communicate a realistic migration period/removal timing, keep the old version working for the promised period. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api022.no-removal OL API-022 MUST_NOT ;; Do not remove an externally consumed version without considering its published support contract. ;; = ;; none ;;
